name: GlobalEventID
description: Identifier of the GDELT event described in this particular news mention; joins to the Events table.

name: EventTimeDate
description: Timestamp at which the original event was first recorded, formatted YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; matches Events.DATEADDED.

name: MentionTimeDate
description: Timestamp of the update that contains this mention, formatted YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.

name: MentionType
description: Source collection identifier; 1 web, 2 citation only, 3 CORE, 4 DTIC, 5 JSTOR, 6 nontextual source.

name: MentionSourceName
description: Readable name of the source, generally the website domain or the publication or archive name.

name: MentionIdentifier
description: Document identifier for the mention, such as an article URL, bibliographic citation, or DOI.

name: SentenceID
description: One based sentence number where the event is mentioned in the source document.

name: Actor1CharOffset
description: Approximate character offset of the first actor reference in the processed document.

name: Actor2CharOffset
description: Approximate character offset of the second actor reference in the processed document.

name: ActionCharOffset
description: Approximate character offset of the action reference in the processed document.

name: InRawText
description: Flag equal to 1 when the event was identified in the original article text, or 0 when text restructuring was needed.

name: Confidence
description: Confidence percentage, typically 10 to 100, in GDELT extracting this event from the source article.

name: MentionDocLen
description: Document length expressed as a count of English characters.

name: MentionDocTone
description: Sentiment tone measured for this particular source document, from negative one hundred to positive one hundred.

name: MentionDocTranslationInfo
description: Semicolon separated information about source language and machine translation software; usually blank for English originals.

name: Extras
description: Reserved field for additional mention metadata; blank in the documented version.

name: ingested_at
description: UTC timestamp when the ingestion pipeline loaded this mention into BigQuery. Added for this project; not in the native GDELT mentions feed.
